background: QIB (UK) is the London subsidiary of Qatar Islamic Bank, the largest Islamic bank in Qatar, offering Sharia-compliant property finance and private banking to Gulf clients in Britain, funded by deposits and the parent.
synthesis: None of Fitch, S&P or Moody's publishes a rating on the UK subsidiary, and the site holds no capital or liquidity figures for it, so there is no peer comparison to make. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. Any comfort comes from the Qatari parent rather than from anything published about the entity itself, so this is a parental-support name: the question for a depositor is how far Qatar Islamic Bank would stand behind its London subsidiary, and nothing shown here answers it.
